scope.description: Value-ballot fidelity at the PrepareReply transport boundary under an actual producer-derived local history.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine messages and successful codec completion
No concurrent producer mutation during observation
excluded: Crash/restart, timer deadlines and eventual client completion

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Bounded constructor-equivalent replicas omit network and execution goroutine startup.
Real SendMsg/Marshal and New/Unmarshal operate over per-link byte buffers.
A decoded PreAcceptReply is held pending while a later Prepare on a different message-type channel is dispatched.
Recovery entry is invoked for a known unresolved slot instead of waiting for the scanner timer.

plan_uncertainties: One nonzero original-owner value ballot is exercised.
No later recovery decision or application effect is claimed.
grounding_unresolved: Global recovery consequence is not claimed.
No end-to-end TCP or recovery quorum decision is executed.
